message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: Theft of 7 guihua (osmanthus) trees from a company's orchard. They dug them up and stole them, value 5400 yuan. This is theft (盗窃). The description: "secretly stole other people's property, with illegal possession purpose, amount large". So the crime is theft (盗窃). Also there is self-surrender (自首) but that doesn't affect label. No other crimes like illegal possession of trees? Could be "盗窃" only. Not "破坏财物" because they stole trees, not just damage. The trees were taken, not destroyed. So theft.

Check correction lessons: There's a rule about "抢夺" vs "盗窃". The case is "secretly" (secret) and "挖掘" (digging) and "盗走". That's theft, not robbery (抢夺) because no violence. So label: 盗窃.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
